findings.finding: Managers initially resisted external interventions in their sales processes.
findings.qualification: This information is self-reported and unverified.

findings.finding: A significant number of clients were initially unaware of the services being offered.
findings.qualification: This is based on observed data but remains unverified.

findings.finding: Some agents struggle to close deals online as effectively as they do in person.
findings.qualification: The claim is self-reported and lacks independent confirmation.

findings.finding: Many real estate transactions are increasingly moving to online platforms.
findings.qualification: This observation is captured twice, possibly indicating broader validation, but it remains unverified.

findings.finding: Agent sales performance does not always correlate with access to quality training and mentorship.
findings.qualification: This is an observed claim but is subject to verification.

findings.finding: Success in sales may rely more on self-belief and consistency than mere skills.
findings.qualification: The advice is opinion-based and lacks empirical backing.

findings.finding: Improvements in conversion rates can be achieved even if not all agents have mastered new sales skills.
findings.qualification: This finding is based on an observed claim, but its general applicability needs further proof.

findings.finding: Personal beliefs about earnings can subconsciously influence agents' sales activities and client targeting.
findings.qualification: The observation is theoretical and requires further investigation to be substantiated.
